verdict.rationale: Proa is a UI framework, so data-flow and reactivity design is a fair question, but the pack never documents a one-way or explicit data-flow model, the absence of two-way bindings, or any state-tracing tooling. The closest evidence is islands that use signals and event handlers with seed state (proa-gh-3, proa-docs-16) and typed request-scoped context (proa-docs-18). These are adjacent reactivity primitives and do not state how state changes flow or can be traced, so they earn no credit.
